06-11-turn-back: Ctrl+Alt+Left: back on face 1 (sunset and chora).
06-12-step-in: A click on the face steps in: xp at 1:1 with the STEP BACK Alt+Esc chip.
06-13-step-back-again: Alt+Escape steps back again to the face with floating windows.
